title: Quick check: Server Rendering Data Requirements

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Server Rendering Data Requirements”?
options: The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Loading data for initial output depends on the selected React framework/runtime and must respect server/client boundaries.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
questions.answer_key: Loading data for initial output depends on the selected React framework/runtime and must respect server/client boundaries.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Server Rendering Data Requirements: Loading data for initial output depends on the selected React framework/runtime and must respect server/client boundaries.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Loading data for initial output?

questions.answer_key: Confirm the chosen framework supports the API and keep server-only dependencies out of client bundles.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Server Rendering Data Requirements: Confirm the chosen framework supports the API and keep server-only dependencies out of client bundles.
